mainEntity.name: Do I need to move out during a whole-home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For major projects that affect kitchens, bathrooms, and bedrooms simultaneously, moving out—at least for part of the construction—often reduces disruption and allows work to proceed more efficiently and safely.
